description: UCI row 74 (age 40, MEDIUM vulnerability, moderate knowledge, RT 2, horizon 8yr) — global equity etf: all hard rules pass (score 100) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Aoife Murphy is 40 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 120,200 euros (around 10,017 euros per month). They hold 2,400 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 2,500 euros with a 8-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has moderate investment experience, including equities, mutual funds, and standard bond instruments. Their investment approach is very conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 2 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 2,500 euros invested. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
